basic_details.offering_entity: King Abdullah Petroleum Studies and Research Center (KAPSARC) & Saudi Ministry of Energy
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: King Abdullah Petroleum Studies and Research Center (KAPSARC, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Energy Economics, Climate Change Economics & Carbon Transition, Computational Energy Modeling, Oil & Gas Market Dynamics, Renewable Energy Grid Integration, Operations Research, Applied Econometrics, and Sustainable Transport Policy.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: Approximately 15 to 20 prestigious Visiting Doctoral Fellowships and Research Grants awarded annually worldwide
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Merit-based global competition; typically 2 to 4 Pakistani doctoral candidates / scholars selected per annual fellowship cohort
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: 6 to 12 months (in-residence doctoral fellowship at KAPSARC headquarters in Riyadh, renewable for up to 24 months for joint dissertation projects)

nationality_requirements: Open to doctoral researchers and PhD candidates of all nationalities worldwide, including Pakistan
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: Applicants must be enrolled doctoral candidates or recent PhD graduates typically under 40 years of age.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Enrollment in an accredited PhD program or recognized Master of Science / MPhil (18-year education) in Energy Economics, Operations Research, Applied Economics, Electrical/Energy Engineering, Data Science, or Environmental Policy with exceptional academic record (minimum CGPA 3.60 / 4.00 or 82%+).
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum CGPA 3.60 / 4.00; competitive applicants have demonstrable research accomplishments and quantitative econometric/modeling skills.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Advanced background in econometric modeling, optimization methods, Python/R/GAMS programming, energy systems simulation, or energy market policy.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Currently enrolled in an accredited PhD program (having completed doctoral coursework / comprehensive exams) or recent doctoral graduate.
eligibility_requirements.graduation_year_restrictions: Must have achieved PhD candidacy within the last 3 years.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Prior research publications in peer-reviewed energy or economics journals (Energy Economics, Applied Energy, Energy Policy) strongly elevate selection chances.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: IELTS Academic minimum 7.0 (no band below 6.5) or TOEFL iBT minimum 95. Research, publications, and seminars are conducted 100% in English.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: Arabic language is not required; research environment is entirely international and English-medium.
eligibility_requirements.gender_specific_requirements: Open equally to male and female scholars; KAPSARC compound provides international residential facilities.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Elite research fellowship awarded to scholars producing high-impact policy analysis on global energy transitions.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Fellows must dedicate full effort to their KAPSARC research program during the fellowship period.

tuition_fee.details: 100% coverage of all institutional research fees, affiliation costs, and computing cluster access at KAPSARC's Zaha Hadid-designed research center in Riyadh.

admission_application_fee.details: Direct application via KAPSARC Fellowship Portal is completely free of charge.

accommodation.details: Free luxurious furnished residential townhouse/villa provided within the secure KAPSARC Residential Community in Riyadh (fully serviced with utilities, high-speed fiber internet, and gym/pool amenities).
accommodation.amount: 100% Free luxury furnished residential housing on KAPSARC compound

monthly_stipend.details: Tax-free monthly research fellowship stipend of SAR 5,000 / month (~PKR 370,000 / month | ~USD 1,335/month | SAR 60,000/year).

airfare.details: Round-trip economy international airfare between Pakistan and Riyadh King Khalid International Airport (RUH) provided at the start and completion of the fellowship.

visa_fee.details: Saudi Business/Research Visa or Saudi Residency Permit (Iqama) fully sponsored, processed, and paid by KAPSARC.

health_insurance.details: Comprehensive premium health and emergency medical insurance through Bupa Arabia covering top private hospitals in Riyadh.

food_allowance.details: Subsidized dining at KAPSARC executive dining hall, cafés, and on-compound markets, complemented by the SAR 5,000 monthly stipend.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Full digital and physical access to KAPSARC Library, proprietary global energy databases (BloombergNEF, S&P Global Platts, Rystad Energy, IEA).
books_and_materials_allowance.amount: 100% Access to premier global energy data repositories

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Full financial sponsorship to present research at premier international energy conferences (IAEE, USAEE, COP) and publish KAPSARC Discussion Papers.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Free shuttle transportation between KAPSARC residential compound, research complex, and key Riyadh destinations.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single host research center (King Abdullah Petroleum Studies and Research Center - KAPSARC, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia).
participating_institutions: King Abdullah Petroleum Studies and Research Center (KAPSARC, Riyadh)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: Ranked as one of the world's premier energy think tanks (Top 10 Global Energy & Resource Think Tanks, Think Tanks and Civil Societies Program); advisory body to G20 and Saudi Ministry of Energy.
available_majors: Climate Change Economics & Carbon Capture, Utilization, and Storage (CCUS)
Renewable Energy Grid Integration & Power Systems
university_and_program_options.program_duration: 6 to 12 months (in-residence research fellowship, extensible to 24 months)
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Enrolled PhD student or recent PhD graduate in economics, energy engineering, or operations research, CGPA >= 3.60/4.00, detailed 5-10 page research proposal aligned with KAPSARC research initiatives, IELTS 7.0+ or TOEFL 95+, two letters of recommendation from doctoral advisors, and writing sample/published paper.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Direct fellowship application to KAPSARC; selection is intensely competitive based on proposal novelty and methodology.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Align proposal directly with Saudi Vision 2030 energy initiatives: circular carbon economy, hydrogen economy, power market reform, or GCC renewable energy integration.

application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Visit kapsarc.org/careers/visiting-fellowships/, create an applicant profile, select 'Visiting Doctoral Fellowship', upload detailed research proposal, writing sample, transcripts, CV, and letters of recommendation before March 1.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Review KAPSARC research themes, active projects, and fellow profiles at kapsarc.org.
Step 2: Draft a comprehensive 5 to 10-page research proposal detailing research objectives, methodology (econometric or optimization), data sources, and policy implications.
Step 3: Prepare academic transcripts, proof of PhD enrollment / candidacy, writing sample (published paper or dissertation chapter), and English test score.
Step 4: Submit the complete application package through KAPSARC Careers / Visiting Fellowships online portal by March 1.
Step 5: KAPSARC Research Directors and Senior Fellows review proposals and evaluate methodological rigor and policy relevance.
Step 6: Shortlisted candidates are invited for a virtual seminar presentation (research seminar + interview) with the KAPSARC research panel in April.
Step 7: Final fellowship award decisions announced in May.
Step 8: KAPSARC Human Resources processes Saudi research visa, flights, and compound housing allocation for Fall arrival.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated Routing: Fellowship application directly submitted to KAPSARC provides both institutional affiliation and complete funding.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted by two doctoral advisors or senior faculty members via referee email upload link.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Motivation letter (1,000 words) describing doctoral research trajectory, motivation for joining KAPSARC in Riyadh, and how the center's resources will advance the candidate's career.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Rigorous 5 to 10-page research proposal specifying: research questions, theoretical framework, quantitative econometric/computational methodology, required datasets, and expected policy deliverables (e.g., KAPSARC Discussion Paper).
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Full academic curriculum vitae detailing doctoral coursework, working papers, journal publications, software skills (Python, R, GAMS, Stata), and conference presentations.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Online research seminar presentation (30 minutes presentation followed by 20 minutes Q&A) before KAPSARC Program Directors and Senior Fellows.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS Academic 7.0+ or TOEFL iBT 95+; GRE scores advantageous for quantitative economics candidates.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: HEC and MoFA Pakistan degree attestations required for Saudi visa processing; Saudi Embassy attestation.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Official English translation for all academic records.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: Online submission via KAPSARC Careers / Visiting Fellowships portal.

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Annual fellowship cycle opens in November with March 1 deadline for September residency; exceptional visiting fellows may be considered on rolling basis.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 25% (Doctoral coursework grades, academic honors, and university standing)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 35% (Quality, methodology, and feasibility of research proposal; publication record)
selection_process_and_weights.work_experience_weight: 5% (Relevant think tank, energy ministry, or policy consulting experience)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 10% (Clarity of motivation, synergy with KAPSARC research initiatives)
selection_process_and_weights.recommendations_weight: 5% (Advisor assessments of candidate research autonomy and scholarly potential)
selection_process_and_weights.interview_weight: 15% (Research seminar presentation, defense of methodology, and responses to panel critique)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: KAPSARC Research Directorate, Program Directors in Energy Transitions and Macroeconomics, and Senior Research Fellows.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Double-blind proposal review followed by competitive research seminar defense before senior researchers.

competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~3.0% to 4.5% among advanced PhD candidates in economics/energy
competitiveness_profile.typical_successful_applicant_gpa: 3.80 / 4.00 (with at least 1-2 published papers or conference proceedings)
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Advanced PhD candidates with sophisticated command of econometric modeling, Python/GAMS, and deep knowledge of energy economics or climate transition.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Doctoral scholars from PIDE (Pakistan Institute of Development Economics), LUMS, NUST, Quaid-i-Azam University, IBA Karachi, and international PhD programs.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Pakistan, United States, United Kingdom, Saudi Arabia, China, Turkey, Egypt, Germany, Italy.

fake_websites_and_scams: Only apply through official KAPSARC website at https://www.kapsarc.org/.
Never pay any fee; KAPSARC never charges application, processing, or visa fees.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Application to KAPSARC fellowships is 100% free.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: KAPSARC does not work with commercial placement agencies or recruiters for research fellowships.
hidden_costs_breakdown: Saudi visa and flights: 100% COVERED by KAPSARC upon selection.
misleading_claims_debunked: Myth: KAPSARC is an oil production company. Reality: KAPSARC is an independent, non-profit energy and sustainability research think tank located in Riyadh.
Myth: Fellows must relocate permanently. Reality: This is an in-residence doctoral fellowship spanning 6-12 months designed to support PhD dissertation completion.
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Unofficial websites state that Arabic proficiency is required to work at KAPSARC; the working language across all research teams at KAPSARC is 100% English.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain active doctoral candidacy in good standing at home university.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time physical residency at KAPSARC research complex in Riyadh during the fellowship tenure; participation in weekly research seminars.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Quarterly milestone reviews with assigned KAPSARC mentor and Program Director.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Fellows must devote full time to their designated research project; outside commercial consulting is prohibited.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: Scholars return to their home university to defend and complete their PhD degree upon fellowship conclusion.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: Fellows must produce at least one KAPSARC Discussion Paper or Policy Brief and present at an internal research seminar.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Revocation of fellowship and termination of residency in case of research misconduct, plagiarism, or abandonment of project without cause.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_university: Not applicable (fellow remains matriculated at home doctoral university).
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Research topic modifications require formal approval from KAPSARC Program Director.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Initial 6-month fellowship can be extended up to 12 or 24 months based on exceptional research progress and joint publication deliverables.
